source.note: Catalog entry so the add-on is ASSESSABLE (org Integrations toggle, agent wire, Autoscaling workspace); the fingerprint row makes it DETECTABLE. supportWindows is deliberately OMITTED for now: Cluster Autoscaler's own rule is 'run the minor that matches the control plane' (its README compatibility table pairs CA 1.N with Kubernetes 1.N), which is a pairing, not a window — transcribing it as one would say every CA on a different minor is unsupported, and the pairing itself has never been an upgrade blocker in the field. No currency hop either: nothing here says a hop is required by the Kubernetes upgrade. The rules for this add-on are LIVE only (src/main/java/io/runtimez/eac/risk/addon/clusterautoscaler/), read from CA's own status ConfigMap projection (agent status.caStatus) and the controller's flags; they reach the Risk tab, RCA and MCP through AddonRuleRegistry.
